name: speedwave-sitemap
description: Provide the URL inventory of a website as structured JSON for other skills to consume. First tries to extract an existing sitemap (robots.txt + common sitemap.xml paths, expanding sitemap indexes); if none is found, crawls the site via the Playwright integration (same-domain, bounded). Use whenever another skill or the user needs "the list of pages", "the sitemap", "all URLs of a site", or a page inventory to audit. Returns JSON only — no SEO analysis, no reports, no recommendations. Do not use for: auditing the pages, generating a sitemap from templates, or anything beyond producing the URL list.
